description: PlumoAI's own AI Employees/CRM product exposed as an MCP server: workspaces, AI Employees, tables (work item types), pipelines, workflow statuses, and records. Lets this AI Digital Employee list AI Employees, inspect table/pipeline/status structure, and list/create/update/comment on records, strictly based on the permissions of the connected plumoai credentials.

triggers.description: Fires when a new record is created on the selected AI Employee/table. Requires the PlumoAI platform's record-events webhook (already configured platform-side) pointed at this trigger's callback endpoint -- this trigger does not create that webhook itself.

ai_employee_id.description: PlumoAI AI Employee to scope this trigger to.

table_id.description: Table (work item type) within the selected AI Employee to scope this trigger to.

record_events.description: Which record event(s) should fire this trigger. Select one or more.

triggers.description: Fires when an existing record is updated (fields and/or workflow status) on the selected AI Employee/table.
